name: Resource and large runtime manager function map
notes: This file tracks confirmed resource-manager functions that are not specific to CSelMode/Czan UI.
Offsets are RAM addresses from main_DDRII.dol unless stated otherwise.

global_managers.confidence: role provisional; size and lifecycle confirmed from GameMain

confirmed_behavior: Runs only when resourceBundle[0] == 0.
Selects a region/layout variant with FUN_80143830(DAT_802E71B8).
Uses path table PTR_s_/banner/banner_US.bin_802A4390 + regionIndex * 8.
Loads eight resources with LoadResourceByPath(*(DAT_802E71B8 + 0x260), pathTable[slot], 0).
Stores each ResourceHandle pointer at resourceBundle[slot + 2].
Calls FUN_80023634(gManager_802E70A4).
Sets resourceBundle[0] = 1 after queuing/loading resources.

notes: ApplyLoadedResources consumes handles from resourceBundle[3]..[9], which correspond to StartLoading slots 1..7.
StartLoading slot 5 is the SSQ_CMN resource and feeds LargeResourceManager_ReloadFromLink.
StartLoading slot 6 is the 2Dcommon/comAF resource and feeds UiRootManager_LoadResource.

slot_relationship.notes: Loaded but not consumed by current ApplyLoadedResources decompile.

confirmed_behavior: Runs only when resourceBundle[0] == 1.
Applies loaded resources only once when resourceBundle[1] == 0.
Wraps the manager setup calls with FUN_80144EA0(1) and FUN_80144EF4().
Sets resourceBundle[1] = 1 after attempting setup.

params.name: linkData
params.role: WII/link resource passed in r4 and forwarded to CzanLinkManager_InitAndSetLink

confirmed_behavior: Initializes a stack link manager through CzanLinkManager_InitAndSetLink(stackLinkManager, linkData).
Listing confirms incoming r4 is passed through as linkData.
Called by BootResourceBundle_ApplyLoadedResources with *(resourceBundle[7] + 0x10).
If largeResourceManager[0] is nonzero, tears down existing manager state before reinitializing.
Loads CzanLinkManager_GetBlock(linkManager, 0) into the sub-manager at largeResourceManager + 0x2FBA7C.
Initializes common/internal state at largeResourceManager + 0x10.
Initializes seven large banks starting at largeResourceManager + 0x91610.
Each bank has stride 0x58534.
Banks 0..4 are initialized with 0x5460.
Banks 5..6 are initialized with 0.
Sets largeResourceManager[0] = 1 before a final refresh.
Releases the stack link manager with CzanLinkManager_Release(linkManager, -1), so no allocator free occurs.
